# nonValidPresentationId

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is **not** a presentation id.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonValidPresentationId() — Checks whether a value is **not** a presentation id. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonValidPresentationId(value: unknown): boolean;
```

`nonValidPresentationId(value)` is the same test as `!isValidPresentationId(value)`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence rather than as a negation.

At least 25 characters of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores — the id from a Slides URL. The format is all that is checked.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is not a presentation id; otherwise `false`.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
nonValidPresentationId("short-id"); // => true
nonValidPresentationId("has space in it and is long enough to pass"); // => true
nonValidPresentationId("1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"); // => false
```
